Commentary.Commentary: We are back for the chase. The players are out in the middle. Fakhar Zaman and Imam-ul-Haq are the openers for Pakistan. Aryan Dutt to start with the ball.
...The Chase...

Now the target should be one which Pakistan should easily chase. Netherlands will have to bowl really well if they are to make a match out of this. There is something in the wicket of the bowlers but can the hosts make use of it? We will find out. Join us in a bit for the second essay.

For Netherlands, it was just about the one partnership and two batters, Tom Cooper and Bas de Leede. Both got a lifeline and then went on to add over 100 as both scored over fifty. None of the others managed to cross the 20-run mark and had a couple of others also played well, they could have got to a competitive total. Bas de Leede stayed till the end but didn't get much support from the other side and he alone tried his best to take hihs team to a decent total.

The new ball bowlers did the job earlier on and then later on it was Mohammad Nawaz who bowled brilliantly. However, all the bowlers had a good outing. Except for Khushdil Shah who only bowled 2 overs, all the others managed a wicket at least.

An excellent display with the ball from Pakistan and they are well and truly on top in this game. The key for them was picking wickets in heaps and that is what dented Netherlands’ chances to get to a good total.

OUT! TAKEN! A full ball in the slot on off and De Leede lofts it high in the air but fails to get enough distance as Fakhar Zaman at long on takes it with ease. An excellent innings from Bas de Leede comes to an end. He tried his best to stay till the end and score some quick runs. Netherlands are all out on 186.
Commentary.Howout: c Fakhar Zaman b Haris Rauf

Commentary.Commentary: Tossed up, outside off, turning away. Kingma blocks it out.
Takes a single now as De Leede slaps it to deep point.
FOUR MORE! Slightly short and outside off. De Leede opens his body and pulls it. It was in the air for a while but in the gap to deep mid-wicket for a boundary.
SIX! BANG! Tossed up, outside off. De Leede slog-sweeps it over cow corner for a biggie.
Full and outside off. De Leede skips down and hits it to mid off. Again he keeps the strike.
Flatter ball, outside off. Left alone.
On a length and on off. De Leede taps it to point and takes a quick single. Wasim slipped as he tried to collect the ball.
Another yorker but De Leede does well to jam it out to square leg for a brace.
A yorker, slightly around off. De Leede keeps it out.
Very full and on middle. De Leede squeezes it to mid on. No run is taken.
SIX! SMASHED AWAY! De Leede will go full throttle now! This is full, slow and outside off. De Leede thumps it over long on for a biggie.
A yorker on middle. De Leede looks to heave across but gets an inside edge onto the pads.
Tossed up on middle. Kingma leans and flicks it to mid-wicket. Tidy from Nawaz.
On middle, blocked to mid on.
Well bowled! Flatter and angling outside off, before straightening up. Vivian Kingma is beaten as he tries to defend.
Serves a full toss on the pads, whipped straight to short fine leg.
Vivian Kingma is the last man in.

OUT! TIMBER! That is wonderfully bowled! Drifts a full ball, around leg and it straightens off the deck. Dutt tries to play the wrong line as he shows full face of the bat but gets beaten on the outside edge and it rattles the leg pole.
Shorter and around off, slapped to covers for a single.
On a length and on middle. Dutt hits it through the line to mid on.
Full and on off, pushed to mid off.
This is good bowling from Wasim! On a length and on leg, swinging in. Dutt misses his flick and gets hit on the pads.
Very full and angling on leg. Dutt looks to flick but misses and gets hit on the leg side. Going down leg.
A length ball, outside off. Dutt has a poke at it but misses.
On the pads, flicked to deep square leg for a single.
Powerplay 3. Now 5 fielders are allowed outside the inner circle till the last over.
Full and on off.  De Leede squirts it through cover for one.
Flatter and on off. Kept out.
Tossed up, around off, spinning away. Dutt splices it to short third man for a single.
Around off, dropped to point for a quick single.
Flighted on leg.  De Leede flicks it to deep mid-wicket. The fielder runs in and throws to the bowler's end. A direct hit could have made things interesting.
Tossed up on middle. Defended to point.
Fuller and on middle, this is pushed to mid off.
Aryan Dutt comes in.

OUT! TWO REDS AND THE ON-FIELD CALL HAS TO BE OVERTURNED! That looked stone dead, not sure why it was not given out. Maybe the umpire felt there is an inside edge. A yorker, inswinging yorker. Comes back in from outside off. Pringle fails to jam it out and gets hit on the toe. A huge shout but the umpire shakes his head. The bowler wants to take the review and his skipper does. Hawk Eye shows three reds. 200 now looks far away.
Doing too much? Maybe! Another big booming inswinger from outside off. Tim looks to drive but misses to get hit on the pads. Maybe clipping leg.
Good length and on off, defended solidly.
Fuller and tailing back in. Bas looks to drive but gets an inside edge onto the pads. It rolls on the leg side for one. Lucky he got bat to that.
Good length and on off, kept out.
This is pushed down to long on for one.
Flatter and on off, kept out.
On middle, defended.
OUT! TAKEN! Shadab comes on and strike in his last over! Tossed up outside off, Logan looks to go downtown but ends up slicing it towards long off where Shah takes an easy catch.
Commentary.Howout: c Naseem Shah b Shadab Khan

On off, this is pushed to cover.
Good length and on off, blocked.
On middle, this is worked through mid-wicket for one.
This one tails back in from off, it is worked to mid on for one.

Fuller and on off, this is pushed through covers for one.
Short and outside off, Bas evades it.

A googly, full and on off. Blocked out.
Tossed up on middle,drilled to long on for one.
Flatter and on middle. Logan van Beek flicks it to square leg for a single.
A single as this is eased to long off.
Tossed up, outside off, driven through covers for a couple of runs.
On off, defended.
Two more! Shorter and outside off, this is cut through point for a couple.

NOT OUT! Two in the end! This is angled into the pads, Logan looks to flick but misses. He gets hit on the pad. A loud shout from the bowler but turned down. Logan is unsure where the ball is and takes off. He then realises it is close to the bowler and turns tog et back in. Wasim picks the ball up and hits the stumps at the keeper's end. Logan dives to get in. It is referred upstairs. Replays show that Logan is in. They take two as the ball deflects away fromt he fielder backing up.
This is guided down to third man for one.
Shorter and outside off, Bas slashes but misses.
On the stumps, this is worked through mid-wicket for one.
On the stumps, blocked.
On the stumps, kept out.
On off, defended.
Shorter and on off, this is pushed through covers for one.
On off, defended.
On off, this is hit down to long off for one.
Good length and on off, this is defended.

Going down leg! That always seemed the case! Angled into the pads. Bas looks to defend but misses. It hits the pad and rolls on the leg side. A leg bye is taken. The bowler appeals but turned down. Pakistan review but replays show that it is going down leg. Review lost.
A bumper, ducked under.
Fuller and on middle, this is pushed to mid on.
That is a good sharp bumper! Logan van Beek is late in the pull, it goes off the splice towards mid-wicket for one.
Outside off, this is guided down to third man for one.
A dot to end! Flatter and on middle, blocked.
Another one on off, this is kept out.
On off, this is pushed to cover.
Around off, this is pushed through covers for one.
On middle, this is worked down to long on for one.
Shorter and outside off, this is slapped through covers for one. This brings up fifty for  De Leede. A good knock from him.
Pitched up, outside off, driven to mid off.
This is full and on middle.  De Leede drills it to the right of mid on for a single.
Outside off, punched through point for a single.
Length and on middle.  De Leede tucks it to mid-wicket for one.
This is full and on off, pushed to mid on.
On a length and nipping back in, on middle, it is nudged to mid-wicket for one.

Slight halt! Naseem Shah has some issue near the landing area and a big hammer comes out. The players take drinks as well. A good comeback from Pakistan after letting a big stand build, they have bogged down Netherlands and will look to take the remaining wickets early.
On off, defended.
Overthrow! Shorter and outside off, this is cut towards point. The throw from the fielder is a wild one to Rizwan. A single in the end.
Another lovely nut! Gets it to angle in on off, it lands and then turns away. Logan is beaten again as he tries to defend.
Shorter and outside off, Logan looks to cut but is beaten.
BEAUT! Slows it up and lands it on off, it pitches and turns away. The batter is beaten as he tries to defend.
Flatter and on off, this is pushed through covers for one.
On middle, this is kept out.
Good length and on off, defended.
Logan van Beek comes in.

OUT! STRANGLED DOWN THE LEG SIDE! Rauf has his second! Fortunate wicket but he won't care! On the pads, Teja Nidamanuru looks to flick but it goes off the inside edge to the left of Rizwan who dives and takes it. Pakistan yet again get three in no time.
Commentary.Howout: c Mohammad Rizwan b Haris Rauf

Commentary.Commentary: On off, defended.
Well fielded again! Shorter and on middle, this is pulled through mid-wicket. The fielder in the deep runs to his left, dives and keeps it down to three.
On middle, this is pushed to mid on.

OUT! EDGED AND TAKEN! Scott Edwards falls now and half the side back in the hut. Pakistan go bang, bang yet again. This lands on middle and then turns away. Edwards leans forward and looks to defend but this turns away, takes the outside edge and the keeper does the rest. Edwards holds his ground but the finger is raised. Netherlands in trouble again now.
Commentary.Howout: c Mohammad Rizwan b Mohammad Nawaz

Commentary.Commentary: On off, this is pushed through covers for one.
The reverse sweep comes out, it is played close to short third man so only one.

Angled into middle, defended.
On middle, Edwards defends it.
On middle, Bas works it to mid-wicket.
Angled into the pads, this is worked down to fine leg for one.
On off, blocked.
That is outstanding fielding! Fuller and on off, this is driven hard towards Shadab at covers. He dives and stops it brilliantly.
On the off pole, this is guided to point.
On off, this is pushed to cover.
On off, this is pushed to covers.
On middle, this is pushed down to long on for one.
On off, this is pushed to covers.

OUT! STRAIGHT BACK TO THE BOWLER! Finally, Pakistan manage to break the stand! Cooper's excellent innings comes to an end in a soft manner. This is flatter and on middle, this lands, holds in the surface and also turns away. Cooper ends up chipping it back to the bowler for an easy catch. The stand is broken and Pakistan will hope they can go back-to-back yet again.

On middle, this is pushed down to long off for one.
Shortish again, this is played through point again for one more.

On off, this is pushed to cover.
On middle, defended.

On off, this is pushed to covers.
DROP AND RUN! On off, this is pushed towards cover for one.
On middle, defended.

FOUR! Beautiful shot from Cooper! This is shorter and outside off, it is cut past point for a boundary. 100-run partnership up. Superb stuff from the two and they are taking their side to safer shores.
On off, defended. They did check if it was a fair delivery and yes it is.

Deft! Brilliantly played! On off, flatter, Bas goes back and  at the end, guides it fine on the off side for two.
On middle, this one turns away. Cooper looks to push at it, it goes off the outside edge towards point for one.
On middle, this is pushed back to the bowler.
On off, this is pushed to cover.
Shorter and outside off, Bas looks to cut but it goes off the outside edge to short third man.
On middle, this is worked to mid-wicket.
Tossed up on off, bas lofts it over covers for two.
Comes down the track and drives but to the man at covers.
Tossed up on off, blocked.
Fires it on the off pole, this is pushed to the man at cover. Another tidy over from Nawaz.
Fuller and on off, Bas pushes it down to long off and takes one.
On off, this is pushed down to long off for one.
Tossed up on off, Tom pushes it to covers.
On middle, blocked.

Fuller and on off, Bas pushes it down to long off for one.
On the stumps, defended.
Tossed up on off, blocked.
A single as this is pushed towards cover.
On off, this is pushed towards cover for one.
FOUR! Nicely cut away! Finds the gap well! Shorter and outside off, this is played past point and it races away to the fence.

Angled into middle, Bas looks to work it on the leg side. It goes off a soft leading edge to cover.

Really hit that well but to the fielder! Comes down the track and hits it firmly down to long off for one.
Flatter and on off, this is pushed down to long off for one.

On middle, this is worked through mid-wicket for one.

FOUR! Fifty for Cooper! Brilliant counter-attacking innings from him and much needed for his side. Shorter and outside off, this is guided past short third man and into the third man fence.
Shorter and outside off, this is cut through point for one.
Shorter and on off, Cooper slaps it down to long off and takes one.
Outside off, Cooper slashes at it, it goes off the outside edge down to third man for one.

And again, the extra bounce! Length and on off, this one takes off too. Cooper looks to defend, it hits the splice.

Lands short! That was a nasty delivery! Length and on off, it lands and takes off. Bas de Leede looks to defend, it goes off the splice but lands short of point.

DRINKS! Netherlands are recovering decently after the loss of the three wickets earlier on. They though need this stand to keep going. Pakistan on the other hand will hope this break works in their favor and they manage to keep picking wickets after it. An important passage awaits.
Misses everything! Tossed up, outside off and it is a googly. Cooper looks to drive but doesn't read the spin. He misses and it goes past the leg stump to square leg.
Fuller ball, outside off. De Leede drags it to deep mid-wicket for one more.
Too full, outside off, driven to long off for a run.
Flatter ball, outside off. Cooper punches it late to point.
Flatter and outside off, quicker. Blocked to point.
On off. De Leede skips down and pushes it to long off for one.
FOUR! Three boundaries in a row! Good rebuild this! Pakistan need to break this stand now as these two are taking it away. Short in length and outside off, it is pulled to deep mid-wicket.
FOUR! This time on the other side. The stand crosses the 50-mark. Length and on middle. Cooper on drives it past mid on for four more.
FOUR! Well played! Length and outside off. Tom shows full face of the bat, hits it through the line, past mid off for a boundary.
Outside off, guided to third man for a single.
Leg bye! On the pads. Cooper misses his flick. It rolls to the left of the keeper of the pads and the batters look for a quick single. The keeper misses his shy at his end. Looked close there. 50 up!
Wasim serves a bouncer, outside off. Cooper looks to pull but misses.
Tossed up, outside off, probably a googly. De Leede punches it to covers.
Full and on off, played back to the bowler.
Floated ball, full and outside off. De Leede works it to point.
Bit of flight, full and on off. Kept out.
Fuller ball, outside off, driven hard and the man at covers lets it through for a single.
Flatter and outside off, spinning away. Defended out.
Fuller ball, around off, tail backs in. De Leede gets an inside edge as he looks to drive onto the pads.
Fuller and on middle. Tom pushes it to mid on for a single.
Short in length and on middle. Cooper hops and blocks it out.
Slides one on the pads. Cooper shuffles across and looks to whip but misses and gets hit on the pads.
Length and on top of off. Cooper punches it to covers.
Angling on the pads. Tom flicks it behind square on the leg side for a brace.
Pitched up, on off, driven to long off for one.
SIX! BANG! Much needed for the Dutch team! Tossed up on middle. Cooper stays back and heaves it high over long on for a biggie.
Too full and on off, De Leede drives it to long off for one.
Flatter and outside off. De Leede punches it straight to point.
Fuller and outside off, punched to deep cover for a single.
Tossed up on off. De Leede drops it wide of point for a single.
Powerplay 2!  Now, 4 fielders are allowed outside the inner circle till the 40th over.
Extra bounce this time, it is on middle. Cooper keeps it out.
A bit straight on the pads. Cooper tucks it behind square leg for a couple.
Length ball, outside off. Cooper works it to covers. Good start by Wasim.
On a length and on off. Tom steps across and splices it to covers.
Short of a length and on middle. Cooper looks to flick but misses and gets hit on the pads.
Serves it on the hips, it is nudged to mid-wicket.
Mohammad Wasim is into the attack.
On a length and outside off. De Leede drops it to covers.
Wide! Too short on this occasion on off. Left alone for a wide.
Around off, fuller and De Leede gets on the front foot to block it.
This is full and on middle. Cooper flicks it past mid-wicket and gets three runs.
Outside off, guided to third man for a single.
Short ball, outside off. De Leede lets it go.
Tad fuller and outside off. Cooper punches it to covers for a sharp single.
Short of a length and outside off. De Leede feels for the ball and has a pike at it but seems to miss it. Shah puts up an appeal but there was nothing on it.
Outside off on a length. De Leede steers it to point.
Wide! Too short, angling down leg. De Leede leaves it for a wide.
Fuller and on off. De Leede hits it straight to covers.
On a length and on middle. De Leede gets inside the line to block it.
Movement off the seam! Shorter and outside off. De Leede shoulders arms to it.
Way outside off. Left alone.
Fuller and on off. Cooper stays back to defend.
Slanting on the pads, pushed to mid on. A bit of fumble and the batters thought to take a single.
A length ball, around off, jags back in sharply. Cooper defends it out. Good bowling this.
A sharp bouncer on middle. Cooper sits under it.
Length and on off. Defended out.
Outside off, guided to third man for a single.
FOUR! A length ball, outside off, it is pulled to deep mid-wicket for a boundary.

NO BALL! Tom Cooper gets a let off. Ohh, dear! Shah's ecstasy turns into disappointment as he gets a lifeline. A length ball, around off, the ball holds onto the surface. Cooper shuffles across and tries to block but does off hard hands and chips it back to Shah. He catches and starts to celebrate. Cooper is just told to wait as a no ball is called. Shah has overstepped.
Around off. Tom dabs it to point. Three dots now.
Length and outside off. Cooper steps across and defends it to mid off.
Short again but this time Cooper tries to block on the up. He misses and gets hit near his ribs.
SIX! Welcome boundary! Short in length and slanting on middle. Cooper gets inside the line of the ball and pulls it all the way over square leg for a six.
Outside off, left alone.
Leg bye! Length and outside off. Cooper tries to drop it in front of point and calls for a quick single. The fielder uns in and underarms it to the keeper's end but Copper was well in.
A length ball, outside off, nips in. Cooper with a solid block.
Angles it full and on middle. De Leede eases it to the right of mid on for a single.
Length and on middle. De Leede nudges it to square leg.
Serves it full and on off. Defended back to the bowler.
Sharp movement off the pitch! Length and outside off, moving away. Left alone.
THREE RUNS! Pitched up, outside off. De Leede punches it to the right of mid off. The outfield is wet and the fielder chases it back to keep it down to three.
Length and outside off. Cooper drives it through covers for a single.
Another solid block from Cooper.
On middle. Blocked out.
Tom Cooper walks out.

OUT! BOWLED! Wesley Barresi goes and he is furious as he walks back. Beautiful bowling from Shah! He makes full use of the pitch. On a length and around off, nips back in sharply. Wesley Barresi is stuck on the crease as he tries to drive away but misses and the ball goes through the gate before hitting the stumps. The Dutch are three down now.
Around off, pushed to covers.
On middle. Kept out.

EDGED AND DROPPED! Just like the first match, the fielding is not so good by Pakistan! A length ball, outside off, jags away. De Leede looks to push but gets an outside edge and in-between the first and second slip fielder. It was the latter's catch as he was standing in front and dived across but fumbles to collect. Fakhar Zaman it was.
On the pads, nudged to mid-wicket.

OUT! TAKEN! Netherlands are in early trouble as they lose another! Rauf pitches it up, outside off. O'Dowd drives it on the up but straight to short extra-cover where Babar Azam takes a sharp catch. It came quickly to him but the skipper did well to hold on.
Commentary.Howout: c Babar Azam b Haris Rauf

Commentary.Commentary: This one is at 140 clicks, on middle. Defended out.
Bangs a short ball, outside off. O'Dowd slashes and misses.
Fuller ball, outside off, pushed to mid off.
This is on top of off. Barresi tucks it to mid-wicket.
Length and outside off, nips in. Blocked to covers.
Short of a length and on off. O'Dowd pulls it to deep square leg for a single.
NO BALL! Length and outside off. Barresi pushes it past mid off and takes three runs. A no ball is given as Shah overstepped. Free hit coming up.
Length and outside off, it is pushed to covers.
Wesley Barresi is the new man in.

OUT! CAUGHT BEHIND! Pakistan break the opening stand pretty quickly. A length ball, outside off, angling across. Singh has a poke at it but tries to play against the angle. He gets an outside edge and Mohammad Rizwan dives to his left to complete the catch. A good catch from the veteran and Naseem Shah strikes on his very first ball.
Commentary.Howout: c Mohammad Rizwan b Naseem Shah

Commentary.Commentary: That was quick at 144 clicks. Length and on middle. O'Dowd closes the face of the bat early and gets a leading edge, straight down and falls safely.
A length ball, outside off, swinging away. O'Dowd shoulders arms to it.
Full and on middle. O'Dowd blocks it out solidly.
Fuller and around off. O'Dowd is hurried as he tries to work it towards cover.
This is full and outside off. Singh guides it to third man and gets off the mark with a single.
A length ball, angling around leg. Singh looks to flick but misses and gets hit on the pads. An appeal for LBW but might be a bit high.

We are all set. The Pakistani players are out in the middle. A historic day for Netherlands as this is their 100th ODI game. Vikramjit Singh and Max O'Dowd are the openers for Netherlands. Haris Rauf to open with the ball.

Babar Azam, the skipper of Pakistan says there is a bit of moisture as there were covers placed throughout due to rain. Adds that the ground is very hard but they are relaxed and ready to go. Says it is good to be here, they have a bunch of fast bowlers and he is happy with the squad. Informs they are unchanged.

Scott Edwards, the skipper of Pakistan says they will bat first. Adds they have been in a winning position but are failing to get over the line. Shares that this condition suits their bowling attack. They are confident and hope to close the game properly. Tells that he is happy to bat where the team requires. Informs they are unchanged.
PITCH REPORT - It was raining earlier but it's a beautiful blue sky right now. The pitch is rock hard. The pitch should play similar to the first game.
Pakistan (Unchanged playing XI) - Fakhar Zaman, Imam-ul-Haq, Babar Azam (C), Mohammad Rizwan (WK), Agha Salman, Khushdil Shah, Shadab Khan, Mohammad Nawaz, Mohammad Wasim, Haris Rauf, Naseem Shah.

Netherlands (Unchanged playing XI) - Scott Edwards (C/WK), Logan van Beek, Tom Cooper, Teja Nidamanuru, Vikramjit Singh, Bas de Leede, Tim Pringle, Max O'Dowd, Wesley Barresi, Aryan Dutt, Vivian Kingma.
TOSS - Netherlands have won the toss and they will BAT first!

Pakistan have one of the best batting line up but their bowling was a shade disappointing. Netherlands showed that and if they put up another tight performance, they have a real chance to equal the series. Will they be able to do it? We will find out soon. Toss and team news in a bit.
